💡 The novelty lies in a high-entropy driven multiscale optimization strategy combining atomic-level A/B-site doping, phase-scale polymorphic domain engineering, grain-scale SiO2-coated core–shell structures, and device-scale electrode barriers. This yields lead-free BaTiO3 MLCCs with 19.8 J·cm−3 energy density, 89.3% efficiency, and excellent thermal/cycling stability, offering a universal route for high-performance dielectric capacitors.

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in showing that metal-dependent Helmholtz capacitance arises primarily from the electrode-side electronic response—specifically noncovalent metal–water polarization controlling electron spillover length—rather than from interfacial water structure. Using ab initio molecular dynamics, the authors reproduce the experimental fcc(111) trend and validate it for cross-geometry Pt/Au systems, providing a predictive, physically grounded design principle for electrode materials in sustainable-energy technologies.

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Vacancy-preconditioning in Li-rich layered oxides enhances Ni–O hybridization and ligand-hole character, shifting oxygen redox earlier and delocalizing holes. This suppresses Mn reduction and induces beneficial structural relaxation, reducing voltage hysteresis and decay. The work directly links vacancy-modified local electronic structure to oxygen-redox structural pathways, offering a design principle for reversible oxygen-redox cathodes.

item.title: Watching Electrochemical Interfaces in Motion with High-Speed Atomic Force Microscopy
item.description:
این چشم‌انداز کاربردهای HS-AFM را برای تصویربرداری operando از پدیده‌های گذرای فصل مشترک الکتروشیمیایی مانند الکتروانباشت، خوردگی و تحول مورفولوژیکی ناشی از لیتیوم‌گذاری مرور می‌کند.
ACS Nano | 💭 Perspective | 🔓 Open Access

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in regulating the spatial distance and orientation of phosphate solvent molecules within the electric double layer to suppress irreversible interfacial spatial electron transfer. Using fluorinated bidentate phosphate ester (TEFP) creates a compact solvation sheath, increasing solvent-cathode distance and directing P═O away from the cathode.
